title: Retained etale origin and stalk marking of one actual finite quotient
statement: Let X be a scheme, d an adic coefficient datum on A, phi_n invertible identifications of the constant A/I^(n+1) rings with the completed finite coefficient sheaves, M a derived completed-module object, V an etale chart, and T a finite perfect adic algebra tower. Assume the level markings of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-stalk-models]. For each n for which T.level n is perfect, there is a bounded etale complex K with finite locally constant cohomology, a retained comparison isomorphism C_n(K) ≅ J_n, and inhabited geometric stalks of Isom(constant(T.level n),K). Here J_n is constructed by applying the exact fixed-coefficient slice restriction [def-weil-pbc-finite-coefficient-slice-restriction] to the actual nth quotient of M. No consecutive transition is part of this conclusion.

proof.text: Construct J_n by exact restriction of the actual quotient to fixed finite scalars and to V. Choose the marking cover and transport its local derived constant-model isomorphisms to these coordinates. The exact constant and coefficient-lift functors identify local homology with constants on the finite homology modules of the perfect model. Conservativity on the cover gives the same bounded interval globally.
For each homology degree, descend the local finite constant models to a finite locally constant etale sheaf G_i and retain its comparison isomorphism.

Apply bounded truncation induction to these homology origins to obtain K and C_n(K) ≅ J_n. Exact faithful comparison reflects the finite cohomological interval; full faithfulness on sheaves lifts the homology isomorphisms to the G_i and gives finite local constancy.

Lift each separably closed geometric point to the marking cover. Pull the retained comparison back to that chart and compose with the marking. The invertible units of the bounded-below comparison adjunction lift the resulting proetale isomorphism to an etale isomorphism. Pullback of constants identifies its source; sheafify the Isom-presheaf section and map it into the geometric fiber.

theorem finitePerfectAdic_marked_origin
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n))
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (V : X.Etale)
    (T : FinitePerfectAdicAlgebraTower d)
    (hmark : FinitePerfectAdicLevelMarkings X d φ M V T) (n : ℕ)
    (hp : DerivedCategory.IsPerfect (T.level n)) :
    ∃ K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf V.left.smallEtaleTopology
      (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))))),
      (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj K)) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj K)) ∧
      Nonempty (((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
        (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))) V.left)
        |>.mapDerivedCategory).obj K ≅
        finitePerfectAdicQuotientCoordinates X d φ M V n) ∧
      (∀ (Ω : Type t) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ V.left),
        Nonempty ((pointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber.obj
          (derivedLocalIsomorphismSheaf (finitePerfectAdicEtaleConstant V.left T n) K)))
